content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a collision involving a pressing chain by relying on what the sign verse itself does not state, so it does the verse-level thing Rule K-C governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the sign itself does not state the mechanism", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "states the contrary in its own words: (1) only a verse stating the contrary in its own words is barred as decisive, so silence about mechanism is different; (2) treating a verse's failure to state the mechanism as decisive is the same verse-by-verse stating test the rule retires.", "why": "The judge makes the sign verse's failure to state the mechanism decisive instead of weighing the competing chains by footing, so it applies the retired verse-level stating test."}
